description: Calculate take-home pay for a given salary in a specific country. Use when the user asks about net pay, take-home salary, or deductions in a country.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code (e.g., "IE" for Ireland, "PT" for Portugal)

name: deel_calculate_take_home_pay
title: Deel Calculate Take Home Pay
